role: independent red-team review of the STATE PREMISE, not of implementation quality

Q1_IS_160_A_BIOLOGICAL_DIMENSION.finding: the repository's own current authority explicitly denies 160 as a production dimensional claim, and the architecture cannot express one

documentary_evidence.context: appears directly beneath a 'Still unresolved' list whose first entries are the production dimensions D_shared, D_private, D_total, D_obs, d_gene

documentary_evidence.quote: d_gene is neural/token capacity, not biological rank.
documentary_evidence.also: Historical 5/96/160/224/320/512 are not production D authority.

architectural_evidence.finding: width=160 is the TOKEN width. The tokenizer emits gene tokens of width 160 and cell_token is an nn.Parameter of shape (1,1,width) prepended to them. cell_state is 160-wide because every token is 160-wide.
architectural_evidence.consequence: 160 is d_gene, which the ledger defines as neural/token capacity. The encoder has no separate knob for a biological state dimension, so its width cannot encode a dimensional claim even in principle.

dimension_framework_evidence.finding: 160 appears only as one point in a COARSE BRACKETING GRID (8,16,...,160,168,...). The controlling frozen amendment states the coarse grid is 'bracket only; local refinement every legal dimension before final freeze', and selecting_dimensions is every integer.
dimension_framework_evidence.consequence: 160 is a grid landmark, never a selected dimension

Q1_IS_160_A_BIOLOGICAL_DIMENSION.defensible_reading: network representation width = 160. The usable biological state may be lower-dimensional or block-structured and is UNDETERMINED.

Q2_V75_SUBSTRATE_VS_CANONICAL_ENCODER.finding: the V75 observer's gene identifiers are synthetic placeholders with no correspondence to canonical vocabulary identities

evidence.what_the_projection_actually_is: a MARGINAL-RATE projection only. operator_availability scales each operator's measured-address fraction to decide HOW MANY of the 96 slots are unavailable, then picks which slots by a hash-ordered score over gid = arange(96). No real address identity enters the choice.
evidence.why_that_is_not_a_mapping: it preserves a measured-support RATE, not an identity correspondence. Slot i does not denote any particular one of the 41,238 addresses.

Q2_V75_SUBSTRATE_VS_CANONICAL_ENCODER.why_it_blocks: the canonical encoder consumes gene_ids through learned gene-identity embeddings indexed by vocabulary position. Feeding ENSG_SYN_* requires inventing a slot assignment, which would manufacture the identity the test is supposed to rely on.

Q3_IS_CELL_STATE_THE_SCIENTIFIC_STATE_OB.what_the_student_sees: view='student': gene_valid = measurement_mask & ~hidden_target_mask (measured genes minus the hidden blocks)

the_jepa_target_tensor.finding: the target is teacher GENE STATES. It is not teacher cell_state.

how_student_cell_state_enters.finding: cell_state is ONE key/value token in a cross-attention memory alongside every student gene state

does_the_loss_constrain_cell_state.loss: F.mse_loss(predicted, target.detach()) over gene block states only

could_gene_states_carry_the_burden_alone.why: the predictor's memory contains all student gene states; nothing forces any information through the single cell token, and a degenerate cell_state would not by itself raise the loss

the_one_objective_that_would_constrain_i.mechanism: cosine distance matrix over teacher and student cell_state
evidence: scripts/agent/audit_teacher_student_integration_freeze_v4.py asserts the runtime text does NOT contain teacher_student_relational_target_v2
the_one_objective_that_would_constrain_i.meaning: the only objective that would make cell_state the scientific state object is deliberately inactive, and an audit enforces its absence

Q3_IS_CELL_STATE_THE_SCIENTIFIC_STATE_OB.conclusion: cell_state is an explicitly returned tensor, not a loss-constrained scientific object. Qualifying it today would qualify an unconstrained byproduct of a gene-level objective.

Q4_WHICH_ENCODER_FOR_DOWNSTREAM_SCIENCE.finding: no authority designating online/student versus EMA teacher as the downstream biological representation was found in the authority index or the formulas/authority ledger

known_runtime_facts.teacher: created by create_ema_target, momentum 0.996, held in .eval()
known_runtime_facts.teacher_receives_no_gradients: enforced; the runtime raises if the EMA target has grads
known_runtime_facts.consequence: the two encoders differ in train/eval behaviour and dropout, so they produce different states for the same cell; which is 'the' state is a scientific choice, not an implementation detail

Q4_WHICH_ENCODER_FOR_DOWNSTREAM_SCIENCE.classification_reason: no authority exists; recorded as unresolved rather than chosen

Q5_WHAT_THE_V75_CONTROLS_CAN_ESTABLISH.challenge_outcome: the repository does NOT support a stronger reading than the one proposed; the freeze's own fields confirm the narrower one

measurement_null.what_it_can_establish: stochastic remeasurement sensitivity UNDER THE SAME OPERATOR
measurement_null.what_it_cannot: cross-technology, cross-operator or cross-platform invariance, because the operator mapping is held identical by construction

biology_positive.what_it_can_establish: sensitivity to a known planted perturbation of the SIMULATOR'S latent under matched measurement

neither_establishes: that the perturbed direction corresponds to any real biology

synthetic_trained_route.trap: training on the same generator and scoring against its planted latent demonstrates recovery of simulator structure, not biology

real_trained_route.status: BLOCKED by Q2. A real-data checkpoint's learned gene-identity embeddings are indexed over the canonical vocabulary; the 96 ENSG_SYN_* slots have no identity correspondence, so evaluating a real checkpoint on them would be evaluating it on scrambled identities.

Q6_CIRCULARITY.does_any_route_avoid_both: NO ROUTE CURRENTLY AVAILABLE AVOIDS BOTH
Q6_CIRCULARITY.what_would_be_needed: either a provenance-safe identity mapping from synthetic slots to canonical addresses, or a synthetic substrate built directly over the canonical 41,238-address vocabulary; neither exists today

WHAT_WOULD_UNBLOCK_IN_ORDER: decide what object is being qualified. Under the canonical objective the loss-constrained object is the GENE-BLOCK representation, not cell_state. Either qualify that, or activate and qualify an objective that constrains cell_state, which is a target-selection decision the project records as having no winner.

resolve the substrate/vocabulary incompatibility honestly: build the synthetic substrate over canonical addresses, or accept that only synthetic-trained, simulator-recovery claims are available and label them as such.
designate student versus EMA teacher as the downstream representation, with a reason.
stop describing 160 as a dimensional claim in any contract; it is token width.
scope: a premise audit. It makes no biological claim and does not evaluate whether the architecture is good, only whether cell_state is the right object to qualify and what dimensional claim the evidence supports.
